reaudit_note: Mechanical re-stamp by `./le rfc reseal`. Every verdict re-stamped below was in the SHIFTED state: its recorded unit fingerprints -- the enclosing top-level function of each tagged test -- were byte-identical to the tree, and only the file around them had moved (a line shift, a sibling test, an import rewrite). Nothing about what any of these tests asserts changed, so no verdict was re-judged and only the `tests` map was rewritten. A verdict whose unit, cited producer code, or requirement text moved was REFUSED and left stale for a human. The proof is the code in verdict_freshness(), not this note.

RFC1997-Encoding-1.note: (a) a COMMUNITIES value that is not a whole set of four-octet values, e.g. 6 octets, silently truncated to one community; (b) TestCommunitiesParseRejectsNonMultipleOf4 require.ErrorIs ErrInvalidLength on 6 octets goes red. Positive TestCommunitiesParse asserts the exact two four-octet communities decoded from 8 octets.

RFC1997-Well-1.note: RFC 1997, Well-known Communities: “All routes received carrying a communities attribute containing this value MUST NOT be advertised outside a BGP confederation boundary (a stand-alone autonomous system that is not part of a confederation should be considered a confederation itself).” Independently re-read all ten tagged covers and both producing egress rails through final ownership admission. Predicate and forwarding pairs distinguish external suppression from internal permission and ordinary-community forwarding. The changed mixed native carrier uses three independent peer processes: all-EOR readiness releases an ordinary source-owned 198.51.100.0/24 seed, both recipients acknowledge its wire receipt, and a source-only marker releases the mixed NO_EXPORT UPDATE. It requires the original withdrawal externally, withdrawal plus permitted announcement internally, the ordinary fence on both, and no external announcement of never-seeded 10.0.0.0/24. The observer checks seeded route-message counts 4/3. The producer retains ordinary ownership for original withdrawals and distinct absent-owner handling for synthesized refused announcements. Scope is the supported stand-alone-AS boundary, not an invented confederation-member implementation or a universal prohibition on all confederation eBGP sessions. Renewed producer-halt records demonstrate reachability, not selective community-decision discrimination.

RFC1997-Well-2.note: Independent source rejudgment. RFC 1997, Well-known Communities, NO_ADVERTISE: 'All routes received carrying a communities attribute containing this value MUST NOT be advertised to other BGP peers.' All 3 positive and 2 negative tagged covers were read. Q1: both internal and external announcements are forbidden, not withdrawals. Q2: internal/component/bgp/wireu/rfc1997_wellknown_test.go TestWellKnownNoAdvertiseRefusesEveryPeer checks false for both peer types; TestWellKnownNoAdvertiseAbsentAdvertisesToEveryPeer checks true for both with an ordinary community. internal/component/bgp/reactor/rfc1997_forward_wellknown_test.go TestForwardNoAdvertiseSkipsEveryPeer checks the announced-destination set, not all UPDATE delivery. test/plugin/wellknown-no-advertise-egress.ci requires 180A0100 withdrawn at BOTH destinations and rejects it only in announced fields (lines 46/52 and 60/65); the ordinary-community fence is positively announced on both sessions (50/63). A rule that leaks, loses withdrawals, or forwards nothing cannot satisfy this combination. Q3: the source supplies valid, separate well-known-community routes followed by a fence; distinct prefixes separate NO_ADVERTISE from NO_EXPORT_SUBCONFED. internal/test/fixture/plugin_fixture_16.go plugin16WellknownCounts quiesces and checks exact outgoing counts; counts are synchronization controls, not the normative assertion, which remains in peer field-scoped expectations/rejections. Q4: 'other BGP peers' is unqualified and both peer classes are covered; no confederation exception is invented. Producers: internal/component/bgp/wireu/wellknown.go ScanWellKnown/AllowsEgressTo and internal/component/bgp/reactor/reactor_api_forward.go suppression-to-withdrawal path with forward_build.go buildWithdrawalPayload. internal/test/peer/checker_update_fields.go separates legacy/MP announcement and withdrawal fields; checker_update_fields_test.go includes real inbound and linger negative-consumer regressions. No newly identified semantic gap within the historical capability scope. Source verdict only, not a claim that this worker executed or renewed runtime proof.

RFC1997-Well-3.note: Independent source rejudgment. RFC 1997, Well-known Communities, NO_EXPORT_SUBCONFED: 'All routes received carrying a communities attribute containing this value MUST NOT be advertised to external BGP peers (this includes peers in other members autonomous systems inside a BGP confederation).' All 3 positive and 2 negative tagged covers were read. Q1: the restriction covers external announcements, with withdrawal delivery still permitted. Q2: internal/component/bgp/wireu/rfc1997_wellknown_test.go TestWellKnownNoExportSubconfedRefusesExternalPeer and TestWellKnownNoExportSubconfedAllowsInternalPeer check opposite predicate outcomes for the same community. internal/component/bgp/reactor/rfc1997_forward_wellknown_test.go TestForwardNoExportSubconfedSkipsExternalPeerOnly requires the internal announced destination and excludes the external one. test/plugin/wellknown-no-advertise-egress.ci requires 180A0200 announced internally (48), requires that prefix withdrawn externally (61), and rejects external announcement (67); the ordinary-community fence must reach both destinations. Missing gate, blanket suppression and withdrawal loss therefore produce different failing assertions rather than interchangeable greens. Q3: the internal allowed-peer control uses the very same received route; separate 180A0100 NO_ADVERTISE input cannot satisfy the 180A0200 assertions. Q4: the parenthesis is retained: a confederation member-AS peer would also be external, but Ze's historical scope has no configurable confederation/member-AS role. No confederation implementation or expanded support is inferred from these tests. Producers: internal/component/bgp/wireu/wellknown.go ScanWellKnown/AllowsEgressTo, internal/component/bgp/reactor/reactor_api_forward.go and forward_build.go buildWithdrawalPayload. The updated peer matcher and its inbound/linger negative-consumer regressions distinguish announcement from withdrawal instead of banning every UPDATE containing the prefix. Source judgment only; parent must supply its actual runtime evidence before stamping.

RFC1997-Well-4.note: First verdict 2026-09-27 (QF-2), row quoted verbatim from the Well-known Communities paragraph. Ze configures no confederation, so the AS boundary is the confederation boundary the sentence's own parenthesis defines. Forbidden: a community-aware speaker that applies the three operations only under operator policy, or not at all. TestWellKnownAllThreeOperationsImplemented asserts all three bits scanned from the wire with no policy and the route refused to both peer kinds; TestForwardWellKnownNeedsNoOperatorPolicy asserts no export filter is configured and the forward set is empty. Negatives: other reserved communities (NOPEER, LLGR_STALE, BLACKHOLE, GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN) carry no egress prohibition (TestWellKnownIgnoresOtherReservedCommunities, TestForwardOtherReservedCommunitiesReachExternalPeer). Enforced.
